flavor: You have just stopped Bullseye from “completing his important work”. He doesn’t take kindly to that.
name: Eyes On The Prize
text: Contents: Bullseye (I) and Bullseye (II). (Bullseye (II) and Bullseye (III) instead for expert mode.) Bullseye and Standard encounter sets. Two modular encounter sets (Ransacked Armory & Tracksuit Mafia). Setup: Each player finds an ally in their deck, puts it into play, and deals damage to it until it has 1 hit point remaining.

name: Eyes On The Prize
text: Treat each acceleration token in play as a [amplify] icon instead. Forced Interrupt: When a boost card on Bullseye is turned faceup, if it is not a Bullseye card, discard it and give him another boost card instead. (Limit once per activation.) If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

flavor: Electro has filled the air with static electricity. Try shuffling your feet on some carpet, maybe?
name: Energetic Enemy
text: Contents: Electro (I) and Electro (II). (Electro (II) and Electro (III) instead for expert mode.) Electro and Standard encounter sets. Two modular encounter sets (Sinister Syndicate & Zzzax). Setup: Each player who has no cards with a printed [energy] resource in their hand seeks a card from their deck with a printed [energy] resource and adds it to their hand.

name: Energetic Enemy
text: Hero Action: Spend [mental] [physical] resources → move a charge counter from Electric Charge to a card you control and ready it. Forced Interrupt: When Electro would attack, if there are no charge counters on Electric Charge, she schemes with +1 SCH instead. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

flavor: Mercenaries, Maggia, and local law enforcement don’t really see eye to eye.
name: Enforcer Entanglements
text: Contents: Hammerhead (I) and Hammerhead (II). (Hammerhead (II) and Hammerhead (III) instead for expert mode.) Hammerhead, Cops, and Standard encounter sets. One modular encounter set (Ransacked Armory). Setup: The first player puts the topmost minion in the encounter deck into play engaged with them. (Shuffle.)

name: Enforcer Entanglements
text:
While you are stunned, [[Police]] minions engaged with you attack the [[Criminal]] or [[Mercenary]] character with the fewest remaining hit points instead.
If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

flavor: Purple Man is commanding wave after wave of innocent civilians under his influence. Stop him!
name: Violet Violence
text: Contents: Purple Man (I) and Purple Man (II). (Purple Man (II) and Purple Man (III) instead for expert mode.) Purple Man and Standard encounter sets. Two modular encounter sets (Streets of Mayhem & Tracksuit Mafia). Setup: Each player searches the encounter deck for an [[Influenced]] minion and reveals it. (Shuffle.)

name: Violet Violence
text: Forced Interrupt: When a [[Civilian]] minion would be discarded, shuffle it into the encounter deck instead. Hero Action: Spend a [wild] resource → choose to either stun or confuse an [[Influenced]] minion. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

flavor: Poor Mary Walker has not one, but two alternate identities that have the ability to cause serious issues for herself and others.
name: Double Trouble
text: Contents: Typhoid Mary (A). (Typhoid Mary (B) instead for expert mode.) Typhoid Mary and Standard encounter sets. Two modular encounter sets (Tracksuit Mafia & Sinister Syndicate). Setup: Reveal the Establish Trust side scheme. Reveal the Disturbed Psyche environment and resolve its “Setup” ability. Give the villain a tough status card.

name: Double Trouble
text: Reduce the amount of damage the villain takes from each attack by 1 for each Typhoid Mary card attached to her. Forced Interrupt: After a token is placed on Disturbed Psyche, find a non-unique Typhoid Mary attachment and attach it to the villain. Replace its printed text box with: “Permanent.” If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.
